conventions.hashes: Merkle leaf data, leaf hashes, node hashes and roots are lowercase hex without 0x. Checkpoint roots, receipt proofs and note signatures are standard padded base64 (RFC 4648 §4), decoded strictly (canonical spelling only).
conventions.merkle: RFC 6962 / RFC 9162 §2.1: leafHash = SHA-256(0x00 || data), nodeHash = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right). Inclusion: verifyInclusion(leafHash, index, size, proof, root). Consistency: verifyConsistency(from, to, fromRoot, toRoot, proof); from = 0 is consistent with anything given an empty proof; equal sizes need equal roots and an empty proof.
conventions.notes: C2SP signed-note (golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/note): open(note, verifierKeys) → {ok:true, body, verifiedBy} or {ok:false, error}; error codes MALFORMED_NOTE, UNVERIFIED_NOTE, INVALID_SIGNATURE, AMBIGUOUS_KEY, INVALID_KEY. Unknown signers are ignored; a known key with a bad signature rejects the note.
conventions.statements: Signed head statements verify against the owner keys of the epoch in effect at statement.head.position: keys of the last ownerKeyEpochs entry with fromPosition <= position. statementHash = sha256 of the canonical encoding of the statement (0x-hex). expect is OK, MALFORMED, UNKNOWN_KEY or SIGNATURE_INVALID.
conventions.entries: canonical is the exact canonical text (continuity-canonical/0.2) whose UTF-8 bytes are the Merkle leaf data; leafHash = SHA-256(0x00 || canonical).
conventions.receipts: verifyWitnessReceipt(receipt, trustedVerifierKeys) → {ok:true, index, checkpoint:{origin,size,root(base64)}} or {ok:false, reason}; reasons RECEIPT_MALFORMED, NOTE_UNVERIFIED, CHECKPOINT_MALFORMED, ORIGIN_MISMATCH, ENTRY_MALFORMED, INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE, INCLUSION_INVALID, checked in that order.
conventions.latestNotes: Witness-signed latest notes (docs/WITNESS.md §9.8): the body is ten lines, `irontrellis-witness-latest/1`, origin, historyId, nonce (canonical unpadded base64url of 16..64 bytes), latest position, latest head hash, leaf index of that HEAD entry (the three are all `none` when the witness holds no head), tree size, equivocation count, supersede count, each ending in a newline. The origin is never the version line. format(fields) → body or MALFORMED_LATEST_NOTE; parse(body) → fields or MALFORMED_LATEST_NOTE; verify(note, trustedVerifierKeys, expect {historyId, nonce, origin?}) → {ok:true, latest:fields} or {ok:false, reason}; reasons EXPECTATION_INVALID (expect is not a plain object whose fields are exactly historyId (a content hash), nonce (a valid nonce) and optionally origin (a note line that is not a version line)), NOTE_UNVERIFIED, LATEST_MALFORMED, ORIGIN_MISMATCH, HISTORY_MISMATCH, NONCE_MISMATCH, checked in that order.
conventions.scenario: Statements, entries and receipts come from conformance/transparency/scenario.mjs: one witness log with two histories. Main history: owner:1 = Ed25519 seed 0x…3001, owner:2 = seed 0x…3002 (after the OWNER_KEYS_ROTATED at position 7, out of an uncommitted epoch). Pre-rotation history (log leaves 7..14): its genesis commits to owner:2's key digest; a head a thief of owner:1 stated after the last good head is superseded by the pre-rotated rotation at position 4 (revealing owner:2, committing to owner:3 = seed 0x…3003). Witness note key irontrellis-witness/vectors = seed 0x77 × 32. Test keys only.

sources.transparency-dev/merkle: github.com/transparency-dev/merkle: testonly/constants.go (main) and proof/verify_test.go (tag v0.0.2); the RFC 6962 vectors also used by certificate-transparency-go
sources.golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/note: github.com/golang/mod sumdb/note/note_test.go (master): TestNewVerifier, TestNewSigner, TestSign, TestOpen
sources.c2sp.org/signed-note: github.com/C2SP/C2SP signed-note.md (main): verifier key example and example notes
